description: Normative release versioning contract. Separates product semver from Scene IR schema and Style Bible package versions. The v1.0.0 git tag must embed this manifest's declared axes and migrations.

release.notes: Creating the annotated git tag is a later release step; this manifest is the contract that tag must satisfy.

framework_semver.role: Product identity for CLI, public TS SDK, and git tags (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

scene_ir_schema_version.role: On-disk Scene IR document schema_version. Independent of framework_semver.

style_package_version.role: Per Style Bible package semver (package_id + version). Independent of framework_semver and Scene IR schema.

authoring_schema_version.role: Authoring document schema_version (may migrate into Scene IR).

benchmark_report_protocol_version.role: Benchmark/report protocol identity from BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md. Not a data IR version.

bump_rules: Bump framework_semver for product/CLI/SDK releases; language of design docs alone does not bump it.
Bump scene_ir_schema_version only when Scene IR on-disk shape or required interpretation changes; ship migrators or reject unsupported versions.
Bump style_package_version per package when tokens/defaults that change pixels change; pin consumers to package_id@version.
Breaking Changes in CHANGELOG.md are mandatory whenever any public axis MAJOR increases or a supported version is dropped.
